exploit_name: Address symmetry incompatibility with account abstraction causes permanent fund loss
description: The unstake function hardcodes msg.sender as destination recipient. Smart contract wallets and multisigs have different addresses across chains due to nonce mismatches.
root_cause: The unstake function hardcodes msg.sender as destination recipient. Smart contract wallets and multisigs have different addresses across chains due to nonce mismatches.
fix_description: Add optional _recipient parameter allowing users to specify destination addresses, defaulting to msg.sender.
notes: Users with AA wallets or multisigs permanently lose assets sent to wrong address on hub chain.
